training_frequency: every two years if still employed
enforcing_agencies: Local government units or law enforcement agencies
required_topics: Definition of human trafficking and commercial exploitation of children
Guidance on identifying individuals most at risk for human trafficking
Difference between labor and sex trafficking relevant to lodging, restaurants, and truck stops
Role of employees in reporting and responding to instances of human trafficking
risks_or_constraints: Employers must provide ongoing training every two years if still employed.
Non-compliance can lead to fines up to $1,500 per offense.
